notice.basis: The advertisement is anonymous: the paper printed the trade and the goods and no proprietor, so no person of this record can carry the reading it was compiled from. What is attested here is what the notice itself set in type — “boot and shoe manufacturing and leather dealing” — and nothing beyond it: no keeper is claimed, and the premises and dates of this record stay on their own blocks at the tier the placement policy left them. Bounded by the printing window (printed 1835-06-24), which dates the notice and not the house.

locations.basis: The paper names a street and no house on it.
locations.limit_reason: The paper names Lake Street and nothing narrower; the paper gives no anchor.

dates.basis: No opening is announced. The first printing, 1835-06-24, is the bound: the house was trading by then and the record does not say when it began.

proprietor_community.basis: This record names nobody the resident layer holds a card for, so there is no person to read a community off. The silence is in the register.

replaceable_by: A directory, a deed or a later reading that names this house's premises, its staff or its dates more exactly than the newspapers do.
